resolved.reason: Supports climbing but plant already has coir pole. Does not identify petiole tie error, specify stem attachment, or give light/repot remedy.

harmfulness.reason: “Tie the plant to the stake” omits which part to attach. In this photo the petiole is already tied, so the answer could perpetuate restrictive support.

specificity_accuracy.reason: “Get it a moss pole” overlooks the pole already present. Support is relevant, but the actionable distinction between stem and leaf stalk and the other recovery needs are missing.

feasibility.reason: Coco coir, wooden stake and twine are ordinary materials with a clear assembly description. Placement on the plant is underspecified, though construction itself is easy.
